title: SET and GET strings
summary: Send SET and GET commands for string values of 16 to 1,024 bytes to a local Redis stand-in, eight commands in flight at a time, and decode each reply.
notes: The server is not Redis. It is a scripted stand-in in its own process that speaks the Redis protocol for these commands and gives fixed replies, the same for every entry; its work is not counted. A client that keeps one connection sends its eight commands down it; a blocking client uses one connection per lane.
